sources.title: Demonstrably Safe AI For Autonomous Driving - waymo.com
sources.snippet: Autonomous driving is the ultimate challenge for AI in the physical world. At Waymo, we're solving it by prioritizing demonstrably safe AI, where safety is central to how we engineer our models and AI ecosystem from the ground up. This post offers a detailed look at Waymo's AI strategy and how it's fueling our momentum, allowing us to safely bring our service to more riders, faster than ...
